latestVersion.changelog: Initial release — 8 battle-tested strategies for reducing token usage in AI agent systems (Claude Code, OpenClaw, GPT Codex, Cursor). Covers context compression, selective loading, prompt deduplication, LLMLingua integration, sub-agent architecture, efficient tool definitions, model tiering, and caching. Includes audit checklist, ROI matrix, and deep-dive reference with LangChain compression pipeline code, TikToken measurement, semantic deduplication, and dollar savings formulas.
